mainEntity.name: How much does a Website Audit for AI Search cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a Website Audit for AI Search varies depending on several factors, including the size and complexity of your website, the depth of analysis required, and the specific goals of the audit. A small business website with fewer pages will typically have a lower cost than a large enterprise site with extensive content. We provide customized quotes after an initial consultation to understand your specific needs and scope. Our audits aim to deliver a strong return on investment through improved AI search visibility and organic traffic.
